description: This file defines a template class SynchronizeType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which provides synchronization mechanisms for message handling, including locking, signaling, and message evaluation.

classes.name: SynchronizeType
classes.description: A template class providing synchronization primitives for message passing, including load, evaluate, flush, and acquire functionalities.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Compares a new message with the stored response, updates state, and signals if successful.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Signals and resets the response state.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a response message into the synchronizer.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the current response state and signals if a specific condition is met.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock with a timeout and checks the response state.
